title: Sherbrooke reference-built block

capture.references: Selected existing 2048x960 perspective JPEGs from a stitched 7680x3840 export. Original pixels copied unchanged. Source times refer to that trimmed export; original INSV offset unverified.

geography.projection: Documented local east/north tangent approximation rotated along Sherbrooke; see block.json coordinates.
geography.extent: Both sides of Sherbrooke Street between Aylmer and George, containing 210 Sherbrooke.
geography.elevation: Flattened for visual comparison. Building heights estimated from footage.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.note: Building-footprint extract and modifications remain available in block.json under ODbL. No warranty of survey accuracy.

sources.title: City of Peterborough Basedata
sources.licence: City of Peterborough Open Data Licence as recorded in source inventory.

method.representation: Conventional polygon buildings, modeled facade details, optional selected planar photo patches. This is not a Gaussian splat or an automatic full reconstruction.
method.sourceOfTruth: Original footage and geographic footprint IDs retained; visual guesses are separate appearance records.
method.productionIntegration: Separate experiment. No production map, routing, collision, dispatch or training systems modified.
method.visibility: Both opposing frontages and corner approaches represented. Hidden/rear geometry and partially occluded facade details are approximate.
method.measurement: Map length is not accepted useful reconstruction coverage. No numerical recognizability score is claimed.
method.comparisonBaseline: Plain footprint massing in this viewer; not an exact copy or measured benchmark of the production simulator.

privacy.publication: Repository owner supplied footage and requested playable public tests.
privacy.mediaSelection: Avoid person/plate-focused crops; inspect selected references before publication.
privacy.syntheticDetail: No generative image fill or invented photographic detail.

rights.ownerMedia: No blanket reuse licence granted for owner footage.
rights.renderer: Three.js existing pinned vendor; MIT notice retained in street-alternatives-v1/vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt

limits: Dimensions, roofs and heights have not been surveyed.
The reference-built scene can improve stable lateral viewing but does not reproduce all visual detail of video.
No measured original camera mounting height; default viewpoint is illustrative.
No physical phone certification or city-scale performance claim.
Production editor import remains a later integration step.

sourceConflicts.evidence: Original 0158_LEFT_SIDE.jpg shows all five doors. Override in buildings.json; original survey metadata preserved.
